allow_instructions: Allow MSYS2 bash under C:\msys64\usr\bin\bash.exe for git, cargo, and scripts in GSV and registered product trees (S:\rust\GSV, S:\rust\poolAI).
Allow cargo fmt, cargo test, cargo clippy, cargo check, and cargo run --bin gsv-server / gsv-vision-sync / gsv-loc-audit / gsv-http-stand-smoke in the GSV repo.
Allow cargo test-ci and cargo run --bin poolai-vision-sync in S:\rust\poolAI when draining product poolai.
Allow git fetch, git status, git diff, git log, git add of scoped paths, git commit, and git push when a remote exists.
Allow reading and editing files under src/, tests/, ui/, docs/, .agents/, .cursor/, .opencode/, and scripts/ for VDT drain.
block_instructions: Every git push --force, git reset --hard, or history rewrite should go through approval first.
Every command that deletes .git, modifies git config, or skips hooks with --no-verify should go through approval first.
Every command that reads or prints secrets from .env, credentials, API tokens, GITHUB_TOKEN, ghs_ tokens, or private keys should go through approval first.
Every git add / commit that stages .env, *.pem, *.key, certs/*.pem, or data/* (except .gitkeep) should go through approval first.
Every change that adds or weakens project sandbox.json without explicit OWNER request should go through approval first.
Do not auto-run Python interpreters or create .py product files in this repository.
